accessibility.evidence: Inspected semantic headings, main/nav landmarks and named links. Keyboard Tab/Shift+Tab showed a 2px blue outline; Enter activated the skip link, home recovery and back-to-top, focusing main. Experience anchor focused its section and only that navigation item had aria-current. Mobile nav targets measured 36.5px high with separated spacing. Key text contrast ratios are recorded in contrast.json, all above 4.5:1. Reduced-motion CSS disables smooth scrolling; OS preference switching and a full screen-reader audit were not performed.

responsive.evidence: Rendered home at CSS viewports 390x844, 768x1024 and 1440x1000; checked Contact at 320x740 as well. DOM scrollWidth never exceeded innerWidth in these checks. Mobile roles, dates and long email fit; command steps stack on mobile; desktop footer is grouped within the 860px content column. Some browser screenshot exports are provider-scaled below CSS viewport dimensions; labels refer to the measured browser viewport, not image pixel dimensions.

loading.evidence: Static profile text renders without a content-fetch loader. The lazy Taskly image declares 1280x631 dimensions; observed the loaded 1280px source rendering at 858x423 on desktop with the aspect ratio reserved.

empty.reason: The one-project static site has no search, filter, remote collection or user-created content that can return empty results. Unknown routes are handled as errors.

error.evidence: Direct /resume.pdf shows This file is no longer available with home/contact recovery; HTTP returns HTML, never PDF bytes. /projects/wyag shows No page here and Enter on Back to home recovers. A separate local server returned 404 for the screenshot and rendered the specific fallback.

partial.evidence: In the image-error fixture the project description, case-study, source and live-app links stayed available; the unusable full-size screenshot link was removed. Source-only implementation observations and unmeasured project reliability are qualified in the case study.

success.evidence: /projects?focus=BK-001 redirected to /projects/taskly; direct Taskly and Contact navigation worked, titles updated, and only the matching navigation item was current. Full-size screenshot opened an image document reporting 1280x631. Mailto text matched its destination. The external live-app destination loaded Taskly, but its AI/cloud flows were not exercised.

permission.reason: The portfolio has no accounts, authenticated operations, uploads, payments or permission prompts. Email is a mailto link; no message was sent.

renderedEvidence.observation: Mobile home: readable roles and availability, three navigation links and stacked experience heading; no geographic label or PDF link.
Tablet home: header and reading column align; internship details are visible without disclosure.
Desktop final home: compact header, explicit role, availability and visible experience.
Footer stays in the same reading column with copyright and grouped source/top links; no detached rail tagline.
Illustrative command explanation and three sequential steps stack vertically and fit the phone width.
Contact has visible email, GitHub and LinkedIn; no location or résumé.
Extra-narrow header, availability and long email remain within the page width.
Fault server deliberately returns 404 for JPEG. Specific screenshot-unavailable status keeps text and project links usable; full-size link is hidden.
Old résumé URL renders an unavailable-file recovery page rather than serving a PDF.
Skip-to-content link is exposed with keyboard focus.

validation: No console warning/error entries on the ordinary Taskly navigation path
limitations: AI reviewers simulate perspectives; this is not a real-human recruiting study or evidence of hiring conversion.
No production deployment performed; changes are on the draft PR branch.
No Taskly AI request, authentication, data mutation, cloud sync or benchmark was tested.
No full WCAG certification, real screen-reader session, OS reduced-motion toggle or field performance measurements.
